title: non stick mini muffin pan
text: non stick mini muffin pan. I had one of these - same brand and everything - accidentally let go of it in a donation purge... so, here I am again.  The old one was 12 spot.. so I upgraded to the 24.  I don't use it that often but every once in a while, you need the mini pan.  You can make mini cupcakes of course... but then there are mini omelet bakes, mini pecan pralines (use foil liners with this one), mini jello bites, fudge etc.... the non stick is great, but FYI - NO dishwasher - always wash non stick by hand.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful!

product_metadata.title: Wilton Perfect Results Premium Non-Stick Mini Muffin Pan & Mini Cupcake Pan, 24-Cavity, Steel
features: READY, SET, BAKE: Bake mini cupcakes or muffins for your celebration with this Perfect Results Premium Non-Stick Mini Muffin Pan. Great for baking cupcakes, mini muffins or small bite-sized appetizers, this 24-cavity mini muffin pan is great to have in your kitchen

PERFORMANCE: The durable construction of this mini muffin pan is designed to spread heat throughout the pan, ensuring your mini treats bake evenly. The large handles make this pan easy to transfer to and from the oven, even while wearing oven mitts

NON- STICK: No matter what you're making, the durable non-stick and scratch-resistant coating on our mini muffin and cupcake pan and allows your food to slide or pop out easily, making cleanup almost effortless
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: This Wilton mini muffin and cupcake pan is dishwasher safe; however for best results, wash in warm, soapy water before first and after each use
INCLUDES: 1 mini muffin and cupcake pan, dimensions: 10 x 16 x 1 inches (25.4 x 40.6 x 2.5 centimeter); Cavity size: 1 x 1.5 inches diameter (2.5 x 3.8 centimeter diameter). Limited 10 year warranty
description: You can use this for morning muffins or to whip up a big batch of mini cupcakes all at once when you've got this non-stick pan on hand.
